title: Pulse Prime
description: Balanced Fabric modpack combining high performance, useful quality-of-life features, enhanced visuals, multiplayer improvements, and shader support for everyday Minecraft gameplay.
body:
# Pulse Prime
Pulse Prime is a balanced Fabric modpack designed for players who want both performance and features.
Built on the foundation of Pulse Lite, Prime adds quality-of-life improvements, visual enhancements, multiplayer tools, and shader support while maintaining smooth performance.

## Features
- ⚡ High FPS optimization
- 🌈 Enhanced visuals and animations
- 🎮 Useful quality-of-life improvements
- 🌐 Multiplayer-friendly
- 🎤 Simple Voice Chat support
-  ✨ Shader support with Iris
- 📱 Compatible with Android, PojavLauncher, and Mojo Launcher
